mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly reduces equity discount rates, compressing valuation multiples and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, the Federal Reserve initiates aggressive tightening, causing equity valuations to contract and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales signal collapsing consumer demand, triggering corporate earnings revisions downward and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market with unemployment above 5.0% and declining employment growth, recessionary pressures emerge, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as corporate profit outlook deteriorates.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS growth is negative, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without additional conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1,100,000 units, it signals a housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 1100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising CPI inflation and stable federal funds rates signals active monetary tightening, causing equity valuations to contract and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL rising and FEDFUNDS stable fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with slowing GDP growth and declining housing starts, the economy approaches a downturn, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as earnings growth decelerates.
failure_condition: In periods of GDPC1 growth < 1.0% and declining HOUST, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.
